瑞恩家族的每个孩子都被当成继承人用心培养，从幼时就开始接受军事训练，巴登也不例外。
Every child born into House Rayne is groomed to become its future head, with military training beginning in early childhood. Baden is no exception.
无论走到哪里，巴登都非常受欢迎——就连钓鱼的时候，他的收获都是最多的。
Baden is well-liked wherever he goes. Even when fishing, the waters seem to favor him, always rewarding him with the biggest catch.
年轻时，巴登曾和瑟恩共同游历过许多地方，足迹遍布耀光帝国。其中很多边境地区都处于战乱之中，因此他们常常向当地的守卫者传授战场上的经验。

Baden spent his youth traveling throughout the Lightbearer Empire with Thane. Many of the border regions they visited were embroiled in war, so they often shared their combat experience with the local defenders.
巴登精通战术与战略，能熟练使用多种武器，还是一位出色的骑手。据说他的堂妹爱丝特瑞达就曾跟随他学习骑术。
Baden is a brilliant tactician, proficient with a wide range of weapons and highly skilled in horseback riding. His cousin, Estrilda, is said to have learned to ride from him.
很少有人知道，巴登其实很喜欢整蛊和恶作剧。就算被整蛊的人是他自己，他也乐在其中。
Few people know that Baden has a mischievous streak. He loves playing pranks and enjoys them just as much when he is on the receiving end.
虽然继承家主之位的时间并不长，但巴登在灰影郡的声望很高。他从战场上失踪后，瑞恩家族没有举行正式的葬礼，灰影郡的民众却自发地为他办了一场盛大的告别仪式。

Baden earned great respect in Ashvale County during his brief tenure as head of House Rayne. After his disappearance on the battlefield, the locals held a grand memorial service in his honor, though his family never held a formal funeral.
巴登从小性格直率，说话时偶尔也会口无遮拦。但随着年龄增长，他渐渐学会了委婉与客套，只有在最亲近的人面前才会暴露本性。
Baden was outspoken from a young age and often spoke without tact. As he matured, he became more diplomatic, revealing his true nature only to those closest to him.
初次见面时，瑟恩对巴登的第一印象并不好，认为他只是一个来军队体验生活的贵族少爷。但一番交手后，巴登用无可置疑的实力扭转了瑟恩的想法。
When they first met, Thane dismissed Baden as a pampered nobleman playing soldier. One duel with Baden changed his mind.
巴登对食物口味的要求非常低，就连一锅不加任何调味品的野菜乱炖都能成为他眼中的美食。这一度让瑟恩怀疑他的味蕾是不是有问题。
Baden has never been picky about food. Even a plain stew of wild greens is a feast to him, which once led Thane to suspect his sense of taste was off.
进入军队时，巴登依照瑞恩家族的传统，从最低的军衔开始服役，凡事亲力亲为。直到他继承家主之位，这个习惯也未曾改变。

Following House Rayne's tradition, Baden began his military career at the lowest rank and learned his duties through hands-on experience. He maintained this approach even after becoming head of the family.
